quirrel: Defaults and their type checks occur at closure creation; allocated defaults stay with that closure.
aside: Evaluate missing defaults at each call, in parameter order, after all actual arguments; new []/{} on each call. Earlier parameters are visible; later parameters and external waiting are forbidden.
handling: Retain upstream creation-time assertions/output. Add separate Aside native positive/negative cases; never silently reuse the old golden.
required_aside_cases: reject later-parameter reference and waiting default

quirrel: Implicit this depends on call context; detached table functions can be rebound using bindenv.
aside: Methods declare self explicitly; method values strongly retain their receiver. Table closures receive no implicit self. Metamethod signatures explicitly include the receiver exactly once.
handling: Class method and ordinary table closure conversions require separate binding review, not global this-to-self replacement.
required_aside_cases: ordinary table closure has no injected argument
subscription removal uses token rather than closure identity

upstream_fixture_scope: Related scalar-field class syntax/inheritance coverage only. classes.nut has no assertion comparing mutable field defaults across two instances and does not establish shared-default aliasing or per-instance allocation behavior.
quirrel: Class field declarations can carry shared mutable default objects.
aside: Initialize fields per instance, base to derived; constructor/failed-instance state and readonly initialization are explicit.
handling: No corresponding original mutable-default aliasing oracle is identified in this baseline. Keep classes.nut, its original results and goldens intact as related class coverage only; add a covering upstream oracle or separate Aside native cases before claiming differential coverage of per-instance field allocation.
required_aside_cases: two instances have independent field arrays
super.init does not repeat field initialization
Failed instance aliases reject ordinary operations

quirrel: null/false/zero are falsy; other values may be truthy. && and || can return an operand.
aside: Conditions, !, && and || require bool; short-circuit logical operators return bool. ?? tests only null.
handling: Do not add truthiness casts to make these original expectations appear compatible.
required_aside_cases: reject int, null, string and container conditions
bool-only short circuit without RHS effects

quirrel: Unsigned-looking hex constants can encode signed wrapped values; shift tests include negative direction reversal. Default CMake SQFloat is float32.
aside: Full int64/float64; checked arithmetic, MIN/-1 and numeric zero division errors; shifts only 0..63. Mixed comparison is exact, not prior int-to-float rounding.
handling: Keep wrapping, negative-shift and float32 oracles in the original suite. The selected optimizer_mul case has only representable int64 values.
required_aside_cases: MAX+1, MIN-1, multiplication, negation and MIN/-1 overflow

quirrel: Plain = requires an existing slot; <-/rawset add slots. Table functions may use implicit this.
aside: Plain table = inserts/overwrites its own slot, never writes a delegate; define/set_existing explicitly constrain existence. Ordinary table writes do not call _set.
handling: Do not preserve old missing-slot throws under ordinary assignment. The converted rawin scenario has no delegate/hooks and maps only own membership to has_own.
required_aside_cases: overwrite retains order; remove/reinsert moves to end
has_own distinguishes missing and stored null

quirrel: String iteration/indexing exposes byte/character integer codes; character literals are integers.
aside: Immutable valid UTF-8; no ambiguous string[i]. Explicit bytes/scalars/codepoints/graphemes and boundary-checked slicing. Shared mutable TextBuffer and ByteBuffer have explicit freezing/view behavior.
handling: Do not mechanically turn char literals into strings or claim byte iteration proves Unicode semantics.
required_aside_cases: buffer aliasing and independent frozen output

quirrel: No corresponding native tuple value-semantic oracle in this reference snapshot.
aside: Tuple is a shallow immutable value, distinct from array/null; exact recursive ordinary equality/hash, fixed arity destructuring and one-value multiple return.
handling: Requires native Aside cases. It cannot be counted as covered by converted array/destructuring fixtures.
required_aside_cases: reject nested mutable/NaN key with element path
